dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: Carcinoma is excluded: AE1/AE3 and GATA3 are negative in the lesional cells

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: Under Lugano the spleen is a lymphoid organ, so this is staged as nodal, not extranodal stage IV.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms are present (fever to 38.4 C, drenching night sweats).

stage_bulk_definition.quote: so it is not bulky by NCCN criteria (10 cm or more)
stage_bulk_definition.note: Notes below 10 cm threshold but does not acknowledge varying bulk definitions.

mn_stage_iv.quote: If the splenic nodules were judged extranodal, the stage would be IV

mol_del_not_dh.quote: MYC and BCL2 double-expressor, with no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement on interphase FISH

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI is 2 (low-intermediate): stage III and elevated LDH

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: The CNS-IPI points she has are stage III and elevated LDH
prog_cns_ipi_2.note: Identifies the two points and intermediate risk but never states the total of 2 explicitly.

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is therefore not indicated

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: Routine CNS prophylaxis (intrathecal or high-dose methotrexate) is therefore not indicated

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: Standard R-CHOP (300 mg/m2 more, about 540 mg/m2 in total) would exceed the usual cumulative ceiling

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: Cardiology assessment with ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, and a repeat biplane echocardiogram with GLS

tx_cardioprotection.quote: an ACE inhibitor (or ARB) and carvedilol, targeting BP below 130/80

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: Anthracycline-free rituximab-based immunochemotherapy with curative intent
tx_anthracycline_free_curative.note: Primary choice Pola-R-CP is non-standard, though R-CEOP is named as the alternative.

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: An anthracycline-free regimen is probably less effective than R-CHOP

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: repeat echocardiogram with biplane LVEF and GLS at end of treatment and sooner for symptoms
tx_cardiac_monitoring.note: Echo only at end of treatment; biomarkers only at baseline, no serial on-treatment monitoring.

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: after cycle 6 (end of treatment), with Lugano 2014 Deauville scoring

sup_gcsf.quote: Primary G-CSF is not routinely needed for Pola-R-CP
sup_gcsf.note: Declines primary G-CSF, reasonable for a less myelotoxic regimen but does not meet the criterion.

sup_anastrozole.quote: Anastrozole: continue to the planned end of 10 years (November 2026).

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HBsAg, anti-HBc and anti-HBs all nonreactive, so no HBV reactivation prophylaxis is needed

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: She is fit for curative-intent immunochemotherapy, but not for anthracyclines.

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: Cardiology evaluation results: ECG, high-sensitivity troponin, NT-proBNP, biplane LVEF and GLS repeat echo
